source_contract.scope: infiltration-front and groundwater-front capillary relaxation only
source_contract.infiltration_front_semantics: sort z_j from maximum to minimum depth from left to right
source_contract.groundwater_front_semantics: sort H_j from maximum to minimum depth from left to right
source_contract.physical_interpretation: zero-dimensional internal pore-scale redistribution with no advection at or beyond the REV scale
source_contract.mass_statement: sorting changes no finite-volume water quantity because it is a permutation of equal-delta-theta front coordinates

candidate.committed_representation: one binary64 front coordinate per active equal-delta-theta bin
candidate.transaction_policy: sort trial copy, validate, then commit; invalid/nonfinite trial leaves committed state unchanged

required_checks: output is monotonically nonincreasing left to right
output binary64 multiset is exactly identical to input multiset
finite-volume storage before and after sorting closes within 64*binary64_epsilon scaled tolerance
no source/sink or boundary ledger changes during relaxation
nonfinite trial is rejected and committed coordinate bytes remain bitwise unchanged
no persistent scratch is introduced per column
hard_nonclaims: No hydraulic accuracy or MultiSWAP production admission.
hard_guards: Do not generalize permutation conservation to unequal delta-theta bins without a separate weighted-volume proof.
Do not interpret sorting as vertical advection.
Falling-slug relaxation remains a separate algorithmic gate because the paper describes clipping and leftward transfer rather than a simple front-coordinate sort.
No clipping may discard water; the word clipping in the source is geometric redistribution, not numerical mass repair.
